address: 40A Tran Cao Van Street, Xuan Hoa Ward, Ho Chi Minh City, 722700, Vietnam
bio: Known for premium seafood and a great selection of snails cooked in multiple ways, Bà Cô Lốc Cốc is a shellfish lover's delight. Highlights include snails in coconut soup, curry and steamed with fresh peppercorn. Another signature dish is apple snail with ginger and lemongrass. Each dish is complemented by fresh herb-infused sauces. The menu, available in Vietnamese, English and with pictures, is easy to navigate, and staff are happy to help with recommendations....
